cli.sample.out: Folder to write the sample to
cli.validate.help: Check a folder in the normalized format
cli.extract.help: Extract the selected OneNote pages into the DocAudit format
cli.extract.demo: Use the fictional sample instead of OneNote
cli.extract.done: Done: {total} pages ({fetched} read, {reused} unchanged, {skipped} not selected, {removed} removed) in {path}
cli.select.profile: Use the selection saved in this profile
cli.import.help: Import manual exports (.mht, .docx) from a folder
cli.testnb.help: Create a NEW OneNote notebook with the fictional sample (Windows)
cli.testnb.folder: New folder for the notebook (must not exist)
cli.check.help: Compare an extraction with the fictional sample
cli.group.help: Group pages that describe the same procedure
cli.group.semantic: Also use meaning similarity (local model, optional)
cli.group.scan: Show how many groups each threshold gives, without saving
cli.groupeval.help: Compare the groups with the sample's correct answers
cli.groupmerge.help: Always put two pages in the same group
cli.groupdetach.help: Take a page out of its group
cli.groupdetach.notfound: Page {page} is not in any group
cli.model.help: Download the meaning-similarity model once (the only command that uses the internet)
cli.model.done: Model ready: {model}. From now on it runs offline.
cli.model.missing: sentence-transformers is missing: run Install.bat semantic
cli.compare.help: Compare the pages in each group: conflicts, different steps, duplicates, outdated pages
cli.compare.nogroups: groups.json is missing in {path}: run “group” first.
cli.compare.reason.old: {days} days older than the newest page
cli.compare.done: {groups} groups compared: {conflicts} conflicts, {steps} step differences, {duplicates} duplicates, {stale} probably outdated pages. Nothing was changed.
cli.compareeval.help: Compare the findings with the sample's correct answers
cli.compareeval.result: Conflicts found {found}/{planted} (false alarms {false_rate:.0%}) · steps {steps_found}/{steps_planted} · outdated {stale_found}/{stale_planted} (+{stale_extra} extra) · duplicates {dup_found}/{dup_planted}
